verdict.rationale: Cline documents a first-party CLI. It installs with `npm install -g cline` and supports both interactive terminal sessions and headless automation, with concrete command examples such as piping a git diff into the agent and auto-approved test-fixing runs. Local model support via Ollama and LM Studio is also documented. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI specifically, since community comments describe the editor experience rather than the terminal CLI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal
